text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: svc-telemetry 5xx rate spike detected (12% over baseline). Paging primary oncall. Incident page: https://incidents.internal/redwood/65235 — please acknowledge.
Alex: Ack — I9m seeing the page but I9m at the airport doing check-in, connectivity is flaky. I9m currently primary until 09:30 PT but can hand off if someone can take now.
Priya: I can take primary if Alex needs to drop. Quick question: any recent deploys or config changes? Can someone drop the runbook link and current players?
Marta: no deploys listed in the last 30m on deploy dashboard. Quick metric check: errors concentrated on collector pods. Running a quick log scrape now:
```
kubectl -n telemetry logs -l app=collector --since=10m | grep ERROR | wc -l
# output: 112
```
Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/telemetry/collector-errors?panelId=3
Alex: I did trigger a canary test earlier this morning (around 6523494000) but not a full rollout. @deploy-bot might have more detail. If Priya takes it, I can hand off immediately. Sorry for the timing. :airplane:
Ken: I9m shadowing this window; happy to monitor alerts while Priya flips primary. Priya, if you take over, can you follow the telemetry runbook step list and scale replicas as a first mitigation? I9ll run the checklist and update PD routing. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/telemetry-5xx (pinned).
Priya: Taking primary now. Re-routing pages to me and updating PD. Starting quick mitigation: scale collectors to 6 replicas to clear backlog.
```
kubectl scale deployment/collector -n telemetry --replicas=6
```
Priya: Also bumping ingestion consumer parallelism and checking prefix cache. Noting customer impact: approx 3% of requests delayed >1s, no complete outages reported yet. Will monitor for 15m post-scale.
oncall-bot: Routing update: pages reassigned to Priya. Previous primary Alex set to secondary in PD.
Marta: After the scale, 5xx dropped from 12% -> ~4% within 4 minutes. Still seeing intermittent ERRORs pointing at upstream rate-limiter exceptions. Suggested followups: check downstream throttles and increase circuit-breaker thresholds temporarily.
Priya: Thanks Marta — I9m checking downstream quotas now. If we see errors persist after another 10m, plan is to initiate a rollback of the canary variant (per runbook step 7). Adding this note to incident page.
Ken: Quick bookmark for the team: useful log grep for throttles
```
journalctl -u telemetry-collector | grep -E "throttle|rate_limit|429" -n | tail -n 200
```
sre-shadow: I9m watching alert noise and will escalate to infra team if lag crosses 5min window. Priya — ping me if you want me to run the rollback.
Alex: Boarding now, leaving handoff to Priya. Thanks everyone for quick assist. :thumbsup:
Priya: Taking over. I9ll keep monitoring and post a stable confirmation once 5xx sits <1.5% for 20 minutes. Adding high-level customer impact to the ticket: degraded latency for subset of non-critical telemetry (no customer-facing outages).
Marta: Noted. I9ll keep an eye on the dashboard and watch for resurgence post-scale.
Priya: Update at +10m: 5xx at 2.8%, ingestion lag decreasing. No rollback yet. Will reconfirm at +20m and then mark handoff stable.
Ken: I9ve pinned runbook link and relevant grafana panels in the incident thread. Good handoff — thanks Alex.
Priya: Final note before I close this handoff: steps taken summary: scaled collectors -> increased consumer parallelism -> monitored downstream quota -> no rollback performed. If anything spikes, call me directly or page PD.
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned to Priya. Monitoring active.
